final: {"number": 203, "label": "enhancement", "route": "backlog", "related": [212, 311], "evidence": ["mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/BDDMockito.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/InOrder.java"], "reply": "Thanks for the detailed proposal. Your second option is already in Mockito: BDDMockito.then(mock).should(inOrder) and should(inOrder, mode) have been available since 2.1.0, so then(firstMock).should(inOrder).add(\"was called first\") and then(secondMock).should(inOrder, times(2)).add(\"was called second\") both work today. The first proposal, a fluent form starting from the InOrder object itself, is not in the current code, so this request is still open for that form. Restated: add a BDD-style way to start in-order verification from an InOrder instance."}
